answer: To forge a duplicate identity, an attacker must acquire new hardware and post a fresh bond, while any attempt to reuse history is rejected at the summit of the reputation ledger. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked to a hardware-backed key, and reputation accrues only through verified work epochs. Sybil clusters thus pay full stake per identity, making mass fakery economically irrational. From sa0019's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
